O.outcome_detail: Mean average H-score, indicating patterns consistent with LLM-assisted code development

cells.quote: A more pronounced shift appears in Spring 2025 (mean =4.2), and Spring 2026 (mean =11.9). This suggests a large change in student behavior towards the use of LLM-based assistance, rather than a change driven by a small number of outliers.
cells.note: The study compares naturally occurring semester cohorts; H-score is a detection-system score rather than a direct learning outcome.
